name: Sierra
summary: Sierra, co-founded by Bret Taylor, builds AI agents that handle customer service and sales conversations for large companies.
overview: Sierra builds AI agents that answer customers, resolve issues and complete transactions on behalf of enterprises.

company: Sierra was co-founded in 2023 by Bret Taylor, a former Salesforce co-CEO and chair of OpenAI's board, and Clay Bavor, a former Google executive. It sells AI agents that handle customer conversations for large companies and is paid in part by outcomes such as resolved cases.

In May 2026 Sierra raised $950 million led by Tiger Global and GV at a post-money valuation above $15 billion. It reported about $150 million of annualized revenue in early 2026 and says more than 40% of the Fortune 50 are customers.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Sierra is a leading test of whether AI agents can replace a large share of customer-service work, and of how much enterprises will pay for that.

changed.text: Sierra is founded by Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor.

takeaways: Enterprise adoption is broad, with more than 40% of the Fortune 50 as customers.
The valuation is roughly 100 times reported annualized revenue.
Outcome-based pricing ties revenue to results, not seats.
Competition from Salesforce, other agent startups and AI labs is intense.
